cells.gaps: The 274 of 274 is a count of MMDA sites against planned sites, and the source does not say how many of the 261 assemblies they cover, so no share of assemblies is established. The connection facts disagree: the minister's 2024 statement is institutional (GHA-010), while the Head of the Local Government Service spoke of 'disconnected offices' in September 2026 with no count (GHA-006). On use, the newest row (GHA-009, systems) is a budget instruction to use GIFMIS with no assembly said to do so, so use rests on GHA-012; LITISIP's plan (GHA-003) gives no cost, timetable or period.
cells.note: Stage 3: an institutional connection on the government network is stated live at MMDA sites nationwide, but as a count of sites with no total of assemblies, which is a floor. Stage 4 needs more than half of the 261 assemblies on a share or a count with that denominator, which no row gives.
